as_told.title: Remote viewer describes the moksha target as a grid and cage around a planet

plain: Remote viewers who aimed their minds at moksha, the Hindu idea of release from the cycle of rebirth, say they found not freedom but a trap around the Earth. Remote viewing is the practice of trying to perceive a distant target with the mind alone. A remote viewer named Scott Turner tells it on the show firsthand, saying that when they first described the site, "it's a fence or a grid around a place", a cage around a planet. The philosopher Jason Jorjani, relaying Turner, adds that it is "part of a vast machinery of energy extraction" set up in the solar system at the end of a war that devastated it, which Turner himself does not mention. If true, it would mean souls are being caught and harvested rather than released.
